title: N--REPLACE GENERATORS WEST SHIP ISLAND
agency_path: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE.SER WEST(52000)
detail_text: REPLACE GENERATORS AT WEST SHIP ISLAND, MS FIRM-FIXED PRICE CONTRACT for ELECTRICIAN, MAINTENANCE (installation, maintenance, or repair of equipment for the generation, distribution, or utilization of electric energy). REMOVE (2) trailer mounted 75KW generators (3-PHASE) (salvage UNIT retain by NPS) at Utility Building (MS 42) and INSTALL two (2) trailer mounted 60KW generators (1-PHASE) with built-in enclosures and upgrade SI Electrical System. UPGRADE Electrical system (replace 4 AC breakers with 4 BC breakers, bus bars, plug-in surge protector. etc.) SET-ASIDE: Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business SIMPLIFIED PROCEDURES: NPS will solicit quotations directly from suppliers in the local trade area.
